about: The race course, chapter 4's fourth scene: the long lawn marked in chalk by morning, 42 cells by 18 over Gemini's 21:9 picture (the cell its height over 18, the columns centred), painted as a place (scene-race-base-wide). The rings are sprites (D182). Pictures named here are in art/raw/, which git ignores.
source:
# The race course

Kydux's own art, made for the game and under the GNU GPL, version 3 or
later, like the rest of it.

- Painted by Gemini 3 Pro Image (`gemini-3-pro-image`) from
  `tools/art/prompts/scene-race-base-wide.md`, with the style of
  `art/raw/image-first/field-2k.png`, then edited by it: without its grid
  (`game-race-course-nogrid.md`).
